biotools.summary: Evidence is a web application developed by Helena Bioinformatics for publishing and exploring versioned scientific study records. It connects cohort-level results with methods, completed sensitivity analyses, source files, code and citations. Interactive controls explore released results and documented analytical decisions, with links to the pinned scientific source. The application does not compute new scientific results in the browser and does not provide patient-specific interpretation or clinical decision support.

credit.name: Helena Bioinformatics
credit.note: Bioinformatics software company in Sofia, Bulgaria. Developer and provider of Evidence.
